vocabTest.title: Free English vocabulary test
vocabTest.metaTitle: Free English vocabulary test: how many words do you know?
vocabTest.metaDescription: Take a free 2-minute English vocabulary size test. See about how many words you know, your level from A1 to C2, and books you can read.
vocabTest.intro: You see one word at a time. Tap “I know it” if you know what it means, and “I don't know” if you are not sure: honest answers make the result more accurate. Some words are made up. After 20 words you can see your result; the more you answer, the narrower the range. We do not store your answers on our server. Your last result stays in this browser for 30 days.
vocabTest.explain: This is an estimate. It counts word families, such as "help", "helps" and "helped" as one word.
vocabTest.unreliableTitle: This result may not be accurate
vocabTest.unreliableBody: You ticked many made-up words. Take the test again and tick only words you really know.
vocabTest.missedTitle: Words you may not know yet
vocabTest.missedHint: You answered “I don't know” to these. They are common at your level.
vocabTest.booksIntro: Free books that match your level.
vocabTest.coverage: You can read about {percent}% of the words
vocabTest.booksLink: Not sure which level? Test your English vocabulary in 2 minutes
